name: Life spaceship dab6fb01 on 3-uniform tiling k3-040
description: A period-24 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-040, with touching neighbours, 7 to 23 cells, moving four lattice steps every 24 generations (c/6). It runs the same way in the 32,768 rules from B3/S23 to B3,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S2,3,8,9,10,11,12,13,14. JETCARP's Life census met it in 3,567 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
